title: A neighbour, a parent, a public servant
lede: Ketan has spent his life close to the classroom — as a parent, a volunteer, and a community organizer who shows up when it matters.

cards.title: About Ketan
body: Ketan Purohit has called Ward 12 home for more than two decades. As a parent of two TDSB students and a longtime volunteer coach, he has seen first-hand what our schools do well — and where students and families are being let down.

By background a community organizer and small-business operator, Ketan brings a practical, listen-first approach to public service. He believes the school board works best when it treats parents as partners and puts the day-to-day experience of students at the centre of every decision.

cards.title: What Ketan Brings
body: A full-time commitment to the role — attending every meeting, reading every report, and being reachable when you need answers, not just at election time.

A record of getting things done: organizing neighbourhood safety walks, launching after-school tutoring, and bringing families and educators to the same table. On the board, that means clearer budgets, safer schools, and a relentless focus on student outcomes.
